scope: Venezia Competition and feature-film Orizzonti Competition; official jury prizes and Lion of the Future recipients within those selections. From 2010 medium-length/short films are excluded; earlier regular feature/documentary selections retain all competing works. Events, special/out-of-competition screenings, parallel sections and honorary/collateral awards excluded.
